    private void SetCommandInProgressWarning(global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Shell.State.PendingCommands.CommandExecutionAdmissionDenialReason reason)
    {

        string detail = reason == global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Shell.State.PendingCommands.CommandExecutionAdmissionDenialReason.PendingCommandAlreadyExists

        _serverWarning = new global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Shell.Services.Feedback.CommandFeedbackWarning(
            global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Contracts.Communication.CommandWarningKind.Pending,

    }

    private string ResolveShellLocalized(string key, string fallback)
    {
        try
        {

            return localized.ResourceNotFound || string.IsNullOrEmpty(localized.Value) ? fallback : localized.Value;
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is not OperationCanceledException)
        {
            return fallback;
        }
    }

    private void OnStateChanged(object? sender, EventArgs e) {
        // Story 2-2 ADR-016: surface Confirmed transition to the renderer via OnConfirmed callback.
        // Guard by correlation id so sibling forms of the same command type do not react to
        // another instance's successful submit.
        var current = LifecycleState.Value.State;
        var currentCorrelationId = LifecycleState.Value.CorrelationId;
        if (current == CommandLifecycleState.Confirmed
            && _previousLifecycleState != CommandLifecycleState.Confirmed
            && OnConfirmed.HasDelegate
            && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(_submittedCorrelationId)
            && string.Equals(currentCorrelationId, _submittedCorrelationId, StringComparison.Ordinal)) {
            IsDirty = false;
            _editContext?.MarkAsUnmodified();
            _ = OnConfirmed.InvokeAsync(null);
        }
        _previousLifecycleState = current;
        InvokeAsync(StateHasChanged);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Resolves a field label following the AC3 precedence: an explicit
    /// <c>[Display(Name)]</c> wins, otherwise the runtime <see cref="IStringLocalizer"/>
    /// is consulted, and finally the humanized compile-time label is used as a fallback.
    /// Patch 2026-04-16 P-09 (precedence) + P-04 (narrow catch).

    private string ResolveLabel(string commandPropertyName, string staticLabel, bool hasExplicitDisplay)
    {
        if (hasExplicitDisplay)
        {
            return staticLabel;
        }

        try
        {
            var localized = Localizer[commandPropertyName];
            if (!localized.ResourceNotFound && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(localized.Value))
            {
                return localized.Value;
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is not OperationCanceledException)
        {
            // Localizer misconfiguration (missing resource manager, culture load failure) is non-fatal.
        }

        return staticLabel;
    }

    private static bool IsDerivableField(string commandPropertyName) => commandPropertyName switch
    {
        "MessageId" or "CommandId" or "CorrelationId" or "TenantId" or "UserId" or "Timestamp" or "CreatedAt" or "ModifiedAt" => true,
        _ => false,
    };

    private bool HasClientParseErrors()
    {
        return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(_AmountParseError);
    }

    private void DiscardUnacceptedTerminalObservations(
        string ownerId,
        System.Collections.Generic.HashSet<string> messageIds,
        System.Collections.Generic.Queue<string> messageIdOrder)
    {
        try
        {
            PendingCommandOutcomeResolver.DiscardBufferedByOwner(ownerId);
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (!IsFatalCommandCleanupException(ex))
        {
            // Coordinator cleanup is best-effort on a non-accepted dispatch.
        }
        finally
        {
            messageIds.Clear();
            messageIdOrder.Clear();
        }
    }

    private static bool IsFatalCommandCleanupException(Exception exception) =>
        exception is global::System.OutOfMemoryException
            or global::System.StackOverflowException
            or global::System.Threading.ThreadAbortException
            or global::System.AccessViolationException;

    private void TrackUnacceptedTerminalObservation(
        string messageId,
        System.Collections.Generic.HashSet<string> messageIds,
        System.Collections.Generic.Queue<string> messageIdOrder)
    {
        if (!messageIds.Add(messageId)) return;
        messageIdOrder.Enqueue(messageId);
        int capacity = Math.Max(1, ShellOptions.Value.MaxPendingCommandEntries);
        while (messageIds.Count > capacity
            && messageIdOrder.TryDequeue(out string? oldest))
        {
            if (messageIds.Remove(oldest))
            {
                // The coordinator owns the authoritative bounded buffer; this queue only
                // bounds producer-local bookkeeping until owner-scoped cleanup.
            }
        }
    }

    private static string? CanonicalCommandMessageId(string? value) =>
        string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value) ? null : value.Trim().ToUpperInvariant();

    private async Task OnValidSubmitAsync()
    {
        // Story 2-2 code-review P35 — guard against invocation via RegisterExternalSubmit after form disposal.
        if (_disposed) return;
        // State-guard against rapid double-click: only allow submit from terminal or idle state.
        // (See code-review 2026-04-15, patch P19.)
        var currentState = LifecycleState.Value.State;
        if (currentState != CommandLifecycleState.Idle
            && currentState != CommandLifecycleState.Rejected
            && currentState != CommandLifecycleState.Confirmed)
        {
            return;
        }

        if (HasClientParseErrors())
        {
            _editContext?.NotifyValidationStateChanged();
            return;
        }

        // Story 2-2 code-review P36 — allocate new CTS BEFORE awaiting BeforeSubmit so disposal can cancel it.
        CancellationTokenSource? previous = _cts;
        _cts = new CancellationTokenSource();
        if (previous is not null)
        {
            try { previous.Cancel(); } catch (ObjectDisposedException) { }
            previous.Dispose();
        }

        // Story 5-2 D5 — clear server-driven validation state from the prior submit (auth has already passed if a policy is in scope).
        _serverValidationMessages?.Clear();
        if (_serverFormLevelErrors.Count > 0)
        {
            _serverFormLevelErrors = System.Array.Empty<string>();
        }
        _serverWarning = null;
        _editContext?.NotifyValidationStateChanged();

        if (BeforeSubmit is not null)
        {
            await BeforeSubmit().ConfigureAwait(false);
            if (_disposed || _cts.IsCancellationRequested) return;
        }

        var admission = CommandExecutionAdmissionGate.TryAcquire(new global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Shell.State.PendingCommands.CommandExecutionAdmissionRequest(
            typeof(Counter.Domain.IncrementCommand).FullName ?? nameof(Counter.Domain.IncrementCommand),
            "Send IncrementCommand"));
        if (!admission.IsAdmitted)
        {
            SetCommandInProgressWarning(admission.DenialReason);
            if (_serverWarning is not null)
            {
                CommandFeedbackPublisher.PublishWarning(_serverWarning);
            }
            await InvokeAsync(StateHasChanged);
            if (Logger is not null) { LogSubmitBlockedByConcurrency(Logger, admission.DenialReason, admission.BlockingMessageId); }
            return;
        }

        try
        {
        var correlationId = UlidFactory.NewUlid();
        _submittedCorrelationId = correlationId;
        System.Threading.Interlocked.Exchange(ref _acceptedAssociationSucceeded, 0);
        var cts = _cts;

        // Story 2-3 D5 — lazily activate the lifecycle bridge so ILifecycleStateService receives
        // the typed Fluxor actions. Idempotent + per-circuit; mirrors Story 2-2 D35.
        LifecycleBridgeRegistry.Ensure<IncrementCommandLifecycleBridge>();
        // Story 2-2 D35 — lazily activate the generated subscriber before the first SubmittedAction dispatch.
        LastUsedSubscriberRegistry.Ensure<IncrementCommandLastUsedSubscriber>();

        Dispatcher.Dispatch(new IncrementCommandActions.SubmittedAction(correlationId, _model));
        await InvokeAsync(StateHasChanged);
        if (Logger is not null) { LogCommandSubmitted(Logger, correlationId); }

        // One owner per dispatch prevents callbacks retained by an earlier service invocation
        // from observing or mutating a later submit's lifecycle.
        object lifecycleCallbackGate = new();
        var unacceptedTerminalMessageIds = new System.Collections.Generic.HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
        var unacceptedTerminalMessageIdOrder = new System.Collections.Generic.Queue<string>();
        int lifecycleCallbackClosed = 0;
        int acceptedTerminalAssociation = 0;
        string? acceptedTerminalMessageId = null;
        bool acceptedAssociationSucceeded = false;

        try
        {
            var commandForDispatch = _model;
            global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Shell.State.PendingCommands.CommandTargetSnapshot? commandTarget = null;
            cts.Token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
            var result = await CommandService.DispatchWithLifecycleObservationsAsync(
                commandForDispatch,
                onLifecycleObservation: observation =>
                {
                    if (System.Threading.Volatile.Read(ref lifecycleCallbackClosed) == 1) return;
                    bool dispatchTerminalAction = false;
                    bool terminalApplied = false;
                    if (observation.State is CommandLifecycleState.Confirmed or CommandLifecycleState.Rejected)
                    {
                        lock (lifecycleCallbackGate)
                        {
                            if (System.Threading.Volatile.Read(ref lifecycleCallbackClosed) == 1) return;
                            string? observationMessageId = CanonicalCommandMessageId(observation.MessageId);
                            if (System.Threading.Volatile.Read(ref acceptedTerminalAssociation) == 1
                                && !string.Equals(observationMessageId, acceptedTerminalMessageId, StringComparison.Ordinal))
                            {
                                return;
                            }
                            var pendingOutcomeObservation = new global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Shell.State.PendingCommands.PendingCommandOutcomeObservation(
                            global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Shell.State.PendingCommands.PendingCommandOutcomeSource.LiveNudgeRefresh,
                            observation.State == CommandLifecycleState.Confirmed
                                ? global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Shell.State.PendingCommands.PendingCommandTerminalOutcome.Confirmed
                                : global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Shell.State.PendingCommands.PendingCommandTerminalOutcome.Rejected,
                            MessageId: observation.MessageId,
                            ObservedAt: observation.ObservedAt)
                        {
                            Materiality = observation.Materiality,
                            };
                            var outcomeResolution = System.Threading.Volatile.Read(ref acceptedTerminalAssociation) == 0
                                ? PendingCommandOutcomeResolver.BufferBeforeAccepted(correlationId, pendingOutcomeObservation)
                                : PendingCommandOutcomeResolver.Resolve(pendingOutcomeObservation);
                            if (System.Threading.Volatile.Read(ref acceptedTerminalAssociation) == 0
                                && observationMessageId is not null
                                && outcomeResolution.Status == global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Shell.State.PendingCommands.PendingCommandOutcomeResolutionStatus.Buffered)
                            {
                                TrackUnacceptedTerminalObservation(
                                    observationMessageId,
                                    unacceptedTerminalMessageIds,
                                    unacceptedTerminalMessageIdOrder);
                            }
                            terminalApplied = System.Threading.Volatile.Read(ref acceptedTerminalAssociation) == 1
                                && outcomeResolution.Status is
                                    global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Shell.State.PendingCommands.PendingCommandOutcomeResolutionStatus.Resolved
                                    or global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Shell.State.PendingCommands.PendingCommandOutcomeResolutionStatus.LifecycleDispatchFailed;
                            dispatchTerminalAction = terminalApplied && LifecycleState.Value.State != observation.State;
                            if (terminalApplied)
                            {
                                System.Threading.Interlocked.Exchange(ref lifecycleCallbackClosed, 1);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    if (observation.State is CommandLifecycleState.Confirmed or CommandLifecycleState.Rejected
                        && !terminalApplied) return;
                    // Guard against callbacks arriving after form disposal or cancellation (patch P10).
                    if (_disposed || cts.IsCancellationRequested
                        || (!dispatchTerminalAction && System.Threading.Volatile.Read(ref lifecycleCallbackClosed) == 1)) return;
                    _ = InvokeAsync(() =>
                    {
                        if (_disposed || cts.IsCancellationRequested
                            || (!dispatchTerminalAction && System.Threading.Volatile.Read(ref lifecycleCallbackClosed) == 1)) return;
                        switch (observation.State)
                        {
                            case CommandLifecycleState.Syncing:
                                Dispatcher.Dispatch(new IncrementCommandActions.SyncingAction(correlationId));
                                break;
                            case CommandLifecycleState.Confirmed:
                                Dispatcher.Dispatch(new IncrementCommandActions.ConfirmedAction(correlationId));
                                break;
                            case CommandLifecycleState.Rejected:
                                Dispatcher.Dispatch(new IncrementCommandActions.RejectedAction(correlationId, "Command rejected.", "Review the command and retry.", null, null, null, null));
                                break;
                        }
                    });
                },
                cancellationToken: cts.Token);
            // Story 9.4 — only accepted dispatch associates the immutable pre-dispatch target.
            global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Shell.State.PendingCommands.PendingCommandRegistrationResult? pendingRegistration = null;
            bool accepted = string.Equals(result.Status, "Accepted", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
            if (accepted)
            {
                lock (lifecycleCallbackGate)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        pendingRegistration = PendingCommandOutcomeResolver.AssociateAccepted(new global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Shell.State.PendingCommands.PendingCommandRegistration(
                            CorrelationId: correlationId,
                            MessageId: result.MessageId,
                            CommandTypeName: typeof(Counter.Domain.IncrementCommand).FullName ?? nameof(Counter.Domain.IncrementCommand))
                        {
                            ProjectionTypeName = commandTarget?.ProjectionTypeName,
                            LaneKey = commandTarget?.ViewKey,
                            EntityKey = commandTarget?.EntityKey,
                            ExpectedStatusSlot = commandTarget?.ExpectedStatus,
                            PriorStatusSlot = commandTarget?.PriorStatus,
                            TargetSnapshot = commandTarget,
                        });
                    }
                    catch (Exception)
                    {
                        pendingRegistration = null;
                    }
                    // Associate first so the accepted observation can replay, then discard
                    // every other early observation owned by this producer.
                    DiscardUnacceptedTerminalObservations(
                        correlationId,
                        unacceptedTerminalMessageIds,
                        unacceptedTerminalMessageIdOrder);
                    acceptedAssociationSucceeded = pendingRegistration?.Status is
                        global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Shell.State.PendingCommands.PendingCommandRegistrationStatus.Registered
                        or global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Shell.State.PendingCommands.PendingCommandRegistrationStatus.Merged
                        or global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Shell.State.PendingCommands.PendingCommandRegistrationStatus.MergedTerminal;
                    if (acceptedAssociationSucceeded)
                    {
                        System.Threading.Interlocked.Exchange(ref _acceptedAssociationSucceeded, 1);
                        acceptedTerminalMessageId = CanonicalCommandMessageId(result.MessageId);
                        System.Threading.Interlocked.Exchange(ref acceptedTerminalAssociation, 1);
                        if (pendingRegistration?.Status is global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Shell.State.PendingCommands.PendingCommandRegistrationStatus.MergedTerminal)
                        {
                            System.Threading.Interlocked.Exchange(ref lifecycleCallbackClosed, 1);
                        }
                        unacceptedTerminalMessageIds.Clear();
                        unacceptedTerminalMessageIdOrder.Clear();
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        System.Threading.Interlocked.Exchange(ref lifecycleCallbackClosed, 1);
                    }
                }
                if (pendingRegistration?.Status is global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Shell.State.PendingCommands.PendingCommandRegistrationStatus.InvalidMessageId
                    or global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Shell.State.PendingCommands.PendingCommandRegistrationStatus.InvalidCorrelationId
                    or global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Shell.State.PendingCommands.PendingCommandRegistrationStatus.ConflictingMetadata
                    or global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Shell.State.PendingCommands.PendingCommandRegistrationStatus.Disposed)
                {
                    if (Logger is not null) { LogPendingRegistrationSkipped(Logger, correlationId, pendingRegistration.Status); }
                }
            }

            if (!accepted)
            {
                lock (lifecycleCallbackGate)
                {
                    System.Threading.Interlocked.Exchange(ref lifecycleCallbackClosed, 1);
                    DiscardUnacceptedTerminalObservations(
                        correlationId,
                        unacceptedTerminalMessageIds,
                        unacceptedTerminalMessageIdOrder);
                }
                if (_disposed || cts.IsCancellationRequested) return;
                if (string.Equals(result.Status, "Rejected", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    Dispatcher.Dispatch(new IncrementCommandActions.RejectedAction(correlationId, "Command rejected.", "Review the command and retry.", null, null, null, null));
                }
                else
                {
                    Dispatcher.Dispatch(new IncrementCommandActions.ResetToIdleAction(correlationId));
                }
                return;
            }
            if (!acceptedAssociationSucceeded)
            {
                if (!_disposed && !cts.IsCancellationRequested)
                {
                    Dispatcher.Dispatch(new IncrementCommandActions.ResetToIdleAction(correlationId));
                }
                if (Logger is not null) { LogCommandAcknowledgedDispatchSkipped(Logger, pendingRegistration?.Status, correlationId); }
                return;
            }
            if (_disposed || cts.IsCancellationRequested) return;
            if (pendingRegistration is { Status: global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Shell.State.PendingCommands.PendingCommandRegistrationStatus.MergedTerminal, Entry: { } mergedEntry })
            {
                if (mergedEntry.Status is global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Shell.State.PendingCommands.PendingCommandStatus.Confirmed
                    or global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Shell.State.PendingCommands.PendingCommandStatus.IdempotentConfirmed)
                {
                    if (LifecycleState.Value.State != CommandLifecycleState.Confirmed)
                    {
                        Dispatcher.Dispatch(new IncrementCommandActions.ConfirmedAction(correlationId));
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    if (LifecycleState.Value.State != CommandLifecycleState.Rejected)
                    {
                        Dispatcher.Dispatch(new IncrementCommandActions.RejectedAction(correlationId, "Command rejected.", "Review the command and retry.", null, null, null, null));
                    }
                }
                if (Logger is not null) { LogCommandAcknowledgedDispatchSkipped(Logger, pendingRegistration.Status, correlationId); }
                return;
            }
            Dispatcher.Dispatch(new IncrementCommandActions.AcknowledgedAction(correlationId, result.MessageId));
            if (Logger is not null) { LogCommandAcknowledged(Logger, correlationId, result.MessageId); }
        }
        catch (CommandValidationException ex)
        {
            // Story 5-2 D5 — server-side 400 validation. Map allowlisted fields onto the
            // ValidationMessageStore; surface unknown / global errors form-level. Lifecycle returns to Idle so the user can correct and re-submit (patch P11 mirrors the cancellation path).
            if (_editContext is not null && _serverValidationMessages is not null)
            {
                _serverFormLevelErrors = global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Shell.Services.Validation.ServerValidationApplicator.Apply(_serverValidationMessages, ex, _serverValidationAllowlist, _model!);
                _editContext.NotifyValidationStateChanged();
            }
            Dispatcher.Dispatch(new IncrementCommandActions.ResetToIdleAction(correlationId));
            if (Logger is not null) { LogCommandValidationFailed(Logger, correlationId, ex.Problem.Title); }
        }
        catch (CommandWarningException ex)
        {
            // Story 5-2 D6 — 403/404/429 surface through a separate warning channel. Lifecycle is
            // reset to Idle so the user can react (e.g. wait out a Retry-After) and try again.
            _serverWarning = new global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Shell.Services.Feedback.CommandFeedbackWarning(
                ex.Kind,
                ex.Problem.Title,
                ex.Problem.Detail,
                ex.Problem.EntityLabel,
                ex.RetryAfter);
            CommandFeedbackPublisher.PublishWarning(_serverWarning);
            Dispatcher.Dispatch(new IncrementCommandActions.ResetToIdleAction(correlationId));
            await InvokeAsync(StateHasChanged);
            if (Logger is not null) { LogCommandWarning(Logger, ex.Kind, correlationId, ex.Problem.Title); }
        }
        catch (AuthRedirectRequiredException ex)
        {
            // Story 5-2 D8 — 401: invoke the framework auth redirector. No cache mutation, no
            // lifecycle rejection, no validation pollution. Lifecycle is reset to Idle so
            // the form does not stay locked while the host handles the redirect.
            Dispatcher.Dispatch(new IncrementCommandActions.ResetToIdleAction(correlationId));
            if (Logger is not null) { LogAuthRedirectRequired(Logger, correlationId, ex.Message); }
            await AuthRedirector.RedirectAsync(returnUrl: null, cancellationToken: cts.Token).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
        catch (CommandRejectedException ex)
        {
            Dispatcher.Dispatch(new IncrementCommandActions.RejectedAction(correlationId, ex.Message, ex.Resolution, ex.ErrorCode, ex.ReasonCategory, ex.SuggestedAction, ex.DocsCode));
            // Notify validation pipeline so any stale error state redraws (patch P16).
            _editContext?.NotifyValidationStateChanged();
            if (Logger is not null) { LogCommandRejected(Logger, correlationId, ex.Message); }
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException)
        {
            // Form disposed during submission; the Dispose path already handles state cleanup.
            if (!_disposed)
            {
                // Submit was cancelled without disposal -- reset lifecycle so the user can retry (patch P11).
                // Patch 2026-04-16 P-11: carry the submit correlation so sibling forms ignore this reset.
                Dispatcher.Dispatch(new IncrementCommandActions.ResetToIdleAction(correlationId));
            }
        }
        finally
        {
            // Dispatch has now settled. Non-accepted and exceptional paths close retained
            // callbacks and discard their buffered observations; accepted callbacks remain
            // resolver-capable after navigation or component disposal.
            if (!acceptedAssociationSucceeded)
            {
                lock (lifecycleCallbackGate)
                {
                    System.Threading.Interlocked.Exchange(ref lifecycleCallbackClosed, 1);
                    DiscardUnacceptedTerminalObservations(
                        correlationId,
                        unacceptedTerminalMessageIds,
                        unacceptedTerminalMessageIdOrder);
                }
            }
        }
        }
        finally
        {
            admission.Dispose();
        }
    }

    /// <inheritdoc />
    public void Dispose()
    {
        // Idempotent dispose (patch P18). Blazor can invoke Dispose more than once on teardown.
        if (_disposed) return;
        _disposed = true;
        try
        {
            if (System.Threading.Volatile.Read(ref _acceptedAssociationSucceeded) == 0
                && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_submittedCorrelationId))
            {
                try { Dispatcher.Dispatch(new IncrementCommandActions.ResetToIdleAction(_submittedCorrelationId)); }
                catch (ObjectDisposedException) { }
            }
        }
        finally
        {
            try { _cts?.Cancel(); } catch (ObjectDisposedException) { }
            _cts?.Dispose();
            _cts = null;
            if (_editContext is not null)
            {
                _editContext.OnFieldChanged -= OnEditContextFieldChanged;
            }
            LifecycleState.StateChanged -= OnStateChanged;
            System.GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
        }
    }

    /// <inheritdoc />
    protected override void BuildRenderTree(RenderTreeBuilder builder)
    {
        builder.OpenElement(0, "div");
        // AC3 density: Comfortable by default (patch P13).
        builder.AddAttribute(1, "class", "fc-command-form fc-density-comfortable");
        builder.AddAttribute(2, "data-fc-interactive", _interactiveReady ? "true" : "false");
        builder.AddAttribute(3, "aria-label", "Send IncrementCommand command form");

        builder.OpenComponent<FcLifecycleWrapper>(4);
        builder.AddAttribute(5, "CorrelationId", _submittedCorrelationId);
        builder.AddAttribute(6, "CommandId", "increment");
        builder.AddAttribute(7, "RejectionMessage", BuildFcLifecycleRejectionCopy());
        builder.AddAttribute(8, "RejectionTitle", BuildFcLifecycleRejectionTitle());
        builder.AddAttribute(9, "RejectionDetails", BuildFcLifecycleRejectionDetails());
        builder.AddAttribute(10, "ChildContent", (RenderFragment)(__wrap =>
        {
            __wrap.OpenComponent<EditForm>(0);
            __wrap.AddAttribute(1, "EditContext", _editContext);
            __wrap.AddAttribute(2, "OnValidSubmit", EventCallback.Factory.Create<EditContext>(this, async _ => await OnValidSubmitAsync()));
        RenderFragment<EditContext> formBody = _ => (RenderFragment)(__b =>
        {
            __b.OpenComponent<DataAnnotationsValidator>(0);
            __b.CloseComponent();

            __b.OpenComponent<FluentValidationSummary>(1);
            __b.AddAttribute(2, "EditContext", _editContext);
            __b.CloseComponent();

            if (_serverFormLevelErrors.Count > 0)
            {
                __b.OpenComponent<FluentMessageBar>(3);
                __b.AddAttribute(4, "Intent", MessageBarIntent.Error);
                __b.AddAttribute(5, "Title", "Validation failed");
                __b.AddAttribute(6, "AllowDismiss", true);
                __b.AddAttribute(7, "ChildContent", (RenderFragment)(__msg =>
                {
                    foreach (string error in _serverFormLevelErrors)
                    {
                        __msg.OpenElement(0, "div");
                        __msg.AddContent(1, error);
                        __msg.CloseElement();
                    }
                }));
                __b.CloseComponent();
            }

            if (_serverWarning is not null)
            {
                __b.OpenComponent<FluentMessageBar>(8);
                __b.AddAttribute(9, "Intent", MessageBarIntent.Warning);
                __b.AddAttribute(10, "Title", _serverWarning.Kind == CommandWarningKind.RetryableDispatchFailed ? ShellLocalizer["RetryableDispatchFailedTitle"].Value : (_serverWarning.Title ?? _serverWarning.Kind.ToString()));
                __b.AddAttribute(11, "AllowDismiss", true);
                __b.AddAttribute(12, "ChildContent", (RenderFragment)(__msg =>
                {
                    string body = _serverWarning.Kind == CommandWarningKind.RetryableDispatchFailed ? ShellLocalizer["RetryableDispatchFailedFallback"].Value : (_serverWarning.Detail ?? _serverWarning.EntityLabel ?? "Please review the warning and try again.");
                    __msg.AddContent(0, body);
                    if (_serverWarning.RetryAfter is not null)
                    {
                        __msg.OpenElement(1, "div");
                        __msg.AddContent(2, $"Retry after {_serverWarning.RetryAfter.Value.TotalSeconds:0} seconds.");
                        __msg.CloseElement();
                    }
                }));
                __b.CloseComponent();
            }

            // Field: Amount
            if ((!DerivableFieldsHidden || !IsDerivableField("Amount"))
                && (ShowFieldsOnly is null || System.Array.IndexOf(ShowFieldsOnly, "Amount") >= 0))
            {
            string AmountLabel = ResolveLabel("Amount", "Amount", false);
            __b.OpenElement(13, "label");
            __b.AddAttribute(14, "class", "fc-command-field");
            __b.OpenElement(15, "span");
            __b.AddAttribute(16, "class", "fc-command-field-label");
            __b.AddContent(17, AmountLabel);
            if (true) { __b.AddContent(18, " *"); }
            __b.CloseElement();
            __b.OpenElement(19, "input");
            __b.AddAttribute(20, "class", "fc-command-input");
            __b.AddAttribute(21, "value", _AmountString ?? _model.Amount.ToString(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture));
            __b.AddAttribute(22, "oninput", EventCallback.Factory.Create<ChangeEventArgs>(this, e => OnAmountChanged(e.Value?.ToString())));
            __b.SetUpdatesAttributeName("value");
            __b.AddAttribute(23, "aria-label", AmountLabel);
            __b.AddAttribute(24, "name", "Amount");
            __b.AddAttribute(25, "type", "text");
            __b.AddAttribute(26, "inputmode", "numeric");
            __b.AddAttribute(27, "aria-invalid", !string.IsNullOrEmpty(_AmountParseError));
            __b.CloseElement();
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_AmountParseError))
            {
                __b.OpenElement(28, "div");
                __b.AddAttribute(29, "class", "fc-command-field-message");
                __b.AddAttribute(30, "role", "alert");
                __b.AddContent(31, _AmountParseError);
                __b.CloseElement();
            }
            __b.CloseElement();
            }

            // Field: Note
            if ((!DerivableFieldsHidden || !IsDerivableField("Note"))
                && (ShowFieldsOnly is null || System.Array.IndexOf(ShowFieldsOnly, "Note") >= 0))
            {
            string NoteLabel = ResolveLabel("Note", "Note", false);
            __b.OpenElement(32, "label");
            __b.AddAttribute(33, "class", "fc-command-field");
            __b.OpenElement(34, "span");
            __b.AddAttribute(35, "class", "fc-command-field-label");
            __b.AddContent(36, NoteLabel);
            if (false) { __b.AddContent(37, " *"); }
            __b.CloseElement();
            __b.OpenElement(38, "input");
            __b.AddAttribute(39, "class", "fc-command-input");
            __b.AddAttribute(40, "value", _model.Note);
            __b.AddAttribute(41, "oninput", EventCallback.Factory.Create<ChangeEventArgs>(this, e => { _model.Note = e.Value?.ToString(); NotifyClientFieldChanged("Note"); }));
            __b.SetUpdatesAttributeName("value");
            __b.AddAttribute(42, "aria-label", NoteLabel);
            __b.AddAttribute(43, "name", "Note");
            __b.AddAttribute(44, "type", "text");
            __b.CloseElement();
            __b.CloseElement();
            }

            __b.OpenComponent<FluentButton>(45);
            __b.AddAttribute(46, "Type", ButtonType.Submit);
            __b.AddAttribute(47, "role", "button");
            __b.AddAttribute(48, "aria-label", "Send IncrementCommand");
            // Enable submit in Idle, Confirmed, or Rejected (terminals allow retry) -- patch P3.
            __b.AddAttribute(49, "Disabled",
                !_interactiveReady
                || (LifecycleState.Value.State != CommandLifecycleState.Idle
                && LifecycleState.Value.State != CommandLifecycleState.Confirmed
                && LifecycleState.Value.State != CommandLifecycleState.Rejected));
            __b.AddAttribute(50, "ChildContent", (RenderFragment)(__btn =>
            {
                if (LifecycleState.Value.State == CommandLifecycleState.Submitting)
                {
                    __btn.OpenComponent<FluentSpinner>(0);
                    __btn.AddAttribute(1, "Style", "width: 20px; height: 20px; margin-right: 8px;");
                    __btn.CloseComponent();
                }
                __btn.AddContent(2, "Send IncrementCommand");
            }));
            __b.CloseComponent();
        });
            __wrap.AddAttribute(3, "ChildContent", formBody);
            __wrap.CloseComponent();
        }));
        builder.CloseComponent();
        builder.CloseElement();
    }


    /// <summary>Story 2-5 D4 — joins Fluxor-state Reason + Resolution with '. ' separator; null outside Rejected.</summary>
    private string? BuildFcLifecycleRejectionCopy()
    {
        if (LifecycleState.Value.State != CommandLifecycleState.Rejected) return null;
        var reason = LifecycleState.Value.RejectionReason;
        var resolution = LifecycleState.Value.RejectionResolution;
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(reason) && string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(resolution)) return null;
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(resolution)) return reason;
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(reason)) return resolution;
        return reason + ". " + resolution;
    }

    /// <summary>Story 2-5 D4 — domain-language rejection title ('{DisplayLabel} failed'); null outside Rejected.</summary>
    private string? BuildFcLifecycleRejectionTitle()
        => LifecycleState.Value.State == CommandLifecycleState.Rejected
           ? "Send IncrementCommand failed"
           : null;

    /// <summary>Story 3-4 — carries typed rejection metadata to the lifecycle wrapper.</summary>
    private CommandRejectionDetails? BuildFcLifecycleRejectionDetails()
    {
        if (LifecycleState.Value.State != CommandLifecycleState.Rejected) return null;
        return CommandRejectionDetails.FromOptional(
            LifecycleState.Value.RejectionErrorCode,
            LifecycleState.Value.RejectionReasonCategory,
            LifecycleState.Value.RejectionSuggestedAction,
            LifecycleState.Value.RejectionDocsCode,
            LifecycleState.Value.RejectionResolution);
    }


    private void OnAmountChanged(string? value)
    {
        _AmountString = value;
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))
        {
            _AmountParseError = "A number is required.";
            NotifyClientFieldChanged("Amount");
            return;
        }
        if (int.TryParse(value, NumberStyles.Integer | NumberStyles.AllowLeadingSign | NumberStyles.AllowTrailingWhite | NumberStyles.AllowLeadingWhite, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, out var parsed))
        {
            _model.Amount = parsed;
            _AmountParseError = null;
        }
        else
        {
            _AmountParseError = "Invalid number format.";
        }
        NotifyClientFieldChanged("Amount");
    }
